basics.name: Anand Bhaskaran
basics.label: Senior Business Product Owner | AI & Knowledge Management | Agile Delivery at Scale
basics.summary: Product owner who bridges business and engineering: as Technical Product Manager at Obermatt I owned product roadmaps end-to-end and introduced agile methodologies that lifted a remote engineering team's productivity 20%. At Beekeeper I was Product Owner for the Distributed Templating Engine, running technical investigations, vision-setting, and epic definition for a system that now powers 15% of all platform assets for 10M+ users. My AI depth is current: at LumApps I own an AI-ready data pipeline (AI Brain, a RAG-grounded knowledge layer unifying 5+ systems) that doubles outbound conversions, backed by certifications in RAG architectures and knowledge graphs. MBA-trained to build the business case, define the KPIs, and defend the ROI to executives.

work.name: LumApps
work.summary: Owns AI transformation end-to-end, from production AI agent architecture to company-wide governance and sales enablement strategy. Reports directly to C-level on outcomes.
highlights: Shaped the information architecture for AI Brain, a RAG-grounded knowledge and data pipeline unifying 5+ systems (Salesforce, HubSpot, Pendo, conversation transcripts, product usage) into one time-aware layer every agent reads and writes. Event-driven ingest, a per-agent query and write-back contract, and a freshness layer for data quality, built for interoperability across systems.

Built and deployed production multi-agent workflows for outbound sales on LangGraph and Google ADK over GCP Vertex AI, with prompt engineering and vector-grounded retrieval. 2x open rates, 2x approved opportunities. Forecast: $4M in approved opportunities per quarter; at 25% conversion, $1M in quarterly revenue.

Owned the complete product lifecycle from concept to production: technical discovery, eval pipelines, tracing, tool-selection tuning, and cost-per-request instrumentation, reporting outcomes and ROI directly to C-level.

work.name: Beekeeper AG

Architected Employee Referral System end-to-end as Tech Lead reporting to CIO. Became the platform's top revenue channel ($1.5M+ generated, $500K ARR). Built the strategic roadmap and drove adoption.
Acting hiring manager for AI roles: defined the bar, ran the process, closed candidates, and mentored the AI engineering cohort into engineers who now lead features independently.

Advised multiple portfolio companies on technical hiring, AI strategy, and building engineering cultures that actually ship.

_jobApplication.jobTitle: Senior Business Product Owner AI & Knowledge Management
_jobApplication.jobDescription: Senior Business Product Owner, AI & Knowledge Management, Roche Diagnostics, Sant Cugat del Valles. Owns Service Knowledge Management solutions centered on AI and AI-ready data pipelines for global customer service. Responsibilities: product strategy and roadmap, process automation, data strategy and governance (with IT), lifecycle and delivery management, agile team leadership across multiple squads (IT Solution Owners, Product Designers, developers), stakeholder alignment between senior business leaders and IT/Architecture. Requires: Master's in STEM or Economics/Business Administration or equivalent; 5-10 years in high-tech, engineering, or service-oriented business; confident understanding of LLMs, RAG, prompt engineering, vector databases, AI-ready data pipelines with a strong functional/content-driven translation skill; expert at architecting scalable global workflows end-to-end; proven agile squad leadership; strong stakeholder alignment, business-case building, KPI definition, ROI. Field experience in Roche Diagnostics service business or comparable is a major plus, not required.
_jobApplication.notes: Strong fit: added the Obermatt (Technical Product Manager, 2018-2021, concurrent side role) entry from resume.md, the closest literal Product Owner title and roadmap/agile-leadership experience in the candidate's history, not previously included in the curated resume.json baseline. Beekeeper's Distributed Templating Engine bullet reworded to surface the 'Product Owner' framing that resume.md documents but resume.json's default bullet omitted. Strong AI/RAG/data-pipeline match (LumApps AI Brain, Neo4j and LangGraph certifications). Honest gap: no field experience in Roche Diagnostics' specific service business or comparable global field-service operations; JD calls this 'a major plus,' not a requirement, so not fabricated or treated as a blocker. MBA plus two STEM Master's degrees comfortably satisfies the education requirement.
